en_description:
A handmade wooden urn for your Alsatian, decorated with a finely detailed cold cast bronze relief of the breed. A fitting place for your dog's ashes, made to be kept close at home. Make it truly yours: the name, dates and quote on the engraved nameplate are personalised for your own dog.

THE URN AT A GLANCE
- Handmade wooden urn for pet ashes, made of solid wood and plywood, painted brown
- Relief portrait of a German Shepherd, cast in cold cast bronze (a mix of resin and bronze powder); the relief cannot be personalised
- Engraved nameplate with the name, dates and quote, and a delicate graphic of a paw held in a human hand
- External size: 21 x 29 x 22 cm (8.3 x 11.4 x 8.7 in)
- Internal size: 14 x 21 x 15.5 cm (5.5 x 8.3 x 6.1 in), capacity approx. 4.5 litres (275 cubic inches)
- Brass handles and carved wooden decorations
- Removable lid, not sealed: glue it with any all-purpose glue to close it tightly

A PLACE OF REMEMBRANCE
Saying goodbye to a dog who was part of the family is never easy. This urn gives your companion a dignified place at home, where the memories of walks, play and quiet evenings can stay close. The brass handles and carved decorations give it a classic, timeless look, and the relief portrait of the breed is made with great care for the details that are characteristic of the breed.

PERSONALISATION
Every urn is made to order. Please tell us:
- Name: the name of your dog, as it should appear on the nameplate.
- Dates: dates of birth and death, in any format you like.
- Quote: the nameplate carries "When I needed a hand, you gave me your paw" unless you give us your own exact wording.
The relief cannot be personalised. Personalisation is always included in the price.

Questions about personalising your urn? Send us a message, we will gladly help.

We would be honoured to help you say goodbye to your beloved dog with dignity.

INTERNATIONAL ORDERS
Our products are shipped from Poland, so import charges may apply in some countries. These charges do not apply to EU countries, the United Kingdom and the USA. If you have any doubts, please contact us for details.

tlumaczenia.pl:
Gdy nadejdzie najsmutniejszy dzień, ta ręcznie robiona urna (rasa: Owczarek niemiecki) będzie pięknym i godnym miejscem dla prochów Twojego psa. Odpowiednie miejsce na prochy Twojego psa, stworzone, by mieć je blisko, w domu. Spraw, by była naprawdę wyjątkowa: imię, daty i cytat na grawerowanej tabliczce są spersonalizowane dla Twojego psa.

CO WARTO WIEDZIEĆ O URNIE
- Ręcznie robiona drewniana urna na prochy zwierzęcia, z litego drewna i sklejki, malowana na brązowo
- Portret rasy (Owczarek niemiecki) w postaci płaskorzeźby z brązu odlewanego na zimno (mieszanka żywicy i proszku z brązu); płaskorzeźba nie podlega personalizacji
- Grawerowana tabliczka z imieniem, datami i cytatem oraz delikatną grafiką łapy psa trzymanej w ludzkiej dłoni
- Wymiary zewnętrzne: 21 x 29 x 22 cm (8,3 x 11,4 x 8,7 cala)
- Wymiary wewnętrzne: 14 x 21 x 15,5 cm (5,5 x 8,3 x 6,1 cala), pojemność ok. 4,5 litra (275 cali sześciennych)
- Mosiężne uchwyty i rzeźbione ozdoby z drewna
- Zdejmowane wieczko, które nie jest szczelne: aby zamknąć urnę szczelnie, przyklej je dowolnym klejem uniwersalnym

MIEJSCE PAMIĘCI
Pożegnanie z psem, który był członkiem rodziny, nigdy nie jest łatwe. Ta urna daje Twojemu towarzyszowi godne miejsce w domu, w którym wspomnienia spacerów, zabawy i cichych wieczorów mogą pozostać blisko. Mosiężne uchwyty i rzeźbione ozdoby nadają jej klasyczny, ponadczasowy charakter, a płaskorzeźba rasy jest wykonana z ogromną dbałością o detale charakterystyczne dla rasy.

PERSONALIZACJA
Każda urna powstaje na zamówienie. Podaj nam:
- Imię: imię Twojego psa, tak jak ma się pojawić na tabliczce.
- Daty: daty urodzenia i śmierci, w dowolnym formacie.
- Cytat: tabliczka zawiera napis "When I needed a hand, you gave me your paw" (tylko po angielsku), chyba że podasz własne, dokładne brzmienie.
Płaskorzeźba nie podlega personalizacji. Personalizacja jest zawsze wliczona w cenę.

Masz pytania o personalizację urny? Napisz do nas, chętnie pomożemy.

Będzie dla nas zaszczytem, jeśli pomożemy Ci z godnością pożegnać ukochanego psa.

ZAMÓWIENIA MIĘDZYNARODOWE
Nasze produkty wysyłamy z Polski, dlatego w niektórych krajach mogą zostać naliczone opłaty importowe. Opłaty nie dotyczą krajów UE, Wielkiej Brytanii ani USA. W razie wątpliwości skontaktuj się z nami, a podamy szczegóły.
tlumaczenia.de:
Wenn der traurigste Tag kommt, wird diese handgefertigte Urne (Rasse: Deutscher Schäferhund) ein schöner und würdevoller Ort für die Asche Ihres Hundes sein. Ein würdiger Platz für die Asche Ihres Hundes, gemacht, um sie zu Hause nah bei sich zu haben. Machen Sie sie zu etwas ganz Persönlichem: Name, Daten und Zitat auf dem gravierten Namensschild werden für Ihren Hund personalisiert.

WISSENSWERTES ZUR URNE
- Handgefertigte Holzurne für die Asche von Haustieren, aus Massivholz und Sperrholz, braun gestrichen
- Reliefporträt eines Deutscher Schäferhund aus kalt gegossener Bronze (Mischung aus Harz und Bronzepulver); das Relief kann nicht personalisiert werden
- Gravierte Namensplatte mit Name, Daten und Zitat sowie einer zarten Grafik einer Hundepfote in einer menschlichen Hand
- Außenmaße: 21 x 29 x 22 cm (8,3 x 11,4 x 8,7 Zoll)
- Innenmaße: 14 x 21 x 15,5 cm (5,5 x 8,3 x 6,1 Zoll), Fassungsvermögen ca. 4,5 Liter (275 Kubikzoll)
- Messinggriffe und geschnitzte Holzverzierungen
- Abnehmbarer Deckel, der nicht dicht schließt: Zum festen Verschließen kleben Sie ihn mit handelsüblichem Universalkleber fest

ERINNERUNGSORT
Abschied von einem Hund zu nehmen, der Teil der Familie war, ist nie leicht. Diese Urne gibt Ihrem Begleiter einen würdevollen Platz in Ihrem Zuhause, an dem die Erinnerungen an Spaziergänge, Spiel und ruhige Abende nah bleiben können. Messinggriffe und geschnitzte Verzierungen verleihen ihr einen klassischen, zeitlosen Charakter, und das Reliefporträt der Rasse ist mit großer Sorgfalt für die rassetypischen Details gefertigt.

PERSONALISIERUNG
Jede Urne wird auf Bestellung gefertigt. Bitte teilen Sie uns mit:
- Name: der Name Ihres Hundes, so wie er auf dem Namensschild erscheinen soll.
- Daten: Geburts- und Sterbedatum, in einem beliebigen Format.
- Zitat: Das Namensschild trägt die Inschrift "When I needed a hand, you gave me your paw" (nur auf Englisch), es sei denn, Sie nennen uns Ihren eigenen genauen Wortlaut.
Das Relief kann nicht personalisiert werden. Die Personalisierung ist immer im Preis enthalten.

Haben Sie Fragen zur Personalisierung der Urne? Schreiben Sie uns, wir helfen gern.

Es wäre uns eine Ehre, Sie dabei zu unterstützen, würdevoll von Ihrem Hund Abschied zu nehmen.

INTERNATIONALE BESTELLUNGEN
Unsere Produkte werden aus Polen versendet, daher können in einigen Ländern Einfuhrabgaben anfallen. Diese Abgaben gelten nicht für EU-Länder, das Vereinigte Königreich und die USA. Bei Fragen kontaktieren Sie uns gerne, wir nennen Ihnen die Details.
tlumaczenia.nl:
Wanneer de droevigste dag komt, wordt deze handgemaakte urn (ras: Duitse herder) een mooie en waardige plek voor de as van uw hond. Een passende plek voor de as van uw hond, gemaakt om thuis dichtbij te houden. Maak hem helemaal van uzelf: naam, data en citaat op het gegraveerde naamplaatje worden gepersonaliseerd voor uw hond.

WAT U MOET WETEN OVER DE URN
- Handgemaakte houten urn voor de as van huisdieren, van massief hout en multiplex, bruin geschilderd
- Reliëfportret van een Duitse herder, gegoten in koud gegoten brons (een mengsel van hars en bronspoeder); het reliëf kan niet worden gepersonaliseerd
- Gegraveerd naamplaatje met naam, data en citaat en een subtiele afbeelding van een hondenpoot in een mensenhand
- Buitenmaten: 21 x 29 x 22 cm (8,3 x 11,4 x 8,7 inch)
- Binnenmaten: 14 x 21 x 15,5 cm (5,5 x 8,3 x 6,1 inch), inhoud ca. 4,5 liter (275 kubieke inch)
- Messing handgrepen en gesneden houten versieringen
- Afneembaar deksel dat niet afsluit: lijm het vast met gewone universele lijm om de urn goed te sluiten

PLEK VAN HERINNERING
Afscheid nemen van een hond die deel van het gezin was, is nooit eenvoudig. Deze urn geeft uw metgezel een waardige plek in uw huis, waar de herinneringen aan wandelingen, spel en rustige avonden dichtbij kunnen blijven. De messing handgrepen en gesneden versieringen geven hem een klassiek, tijdloos karakter en het reliëfportret van het ras is gemaakt met veel zorg voor de kenmerkende details van het ras.

PERSONALISATIE
Elke urn wordt op bestelling gemaakt. Laat ons weten:
- Naam: de naam van uw hond, zoals die op het naamplaatje moet staan.
- Data: geboorte- en overlijdensdatum, in elk gewenst formaat.
- Citaat: het naamplaatje draagt de tekst "When I needed a hand, you gave me your paw" (alleen in het Engels), tenzij u ons uw eigen exacte tekst geeft.
Het reliëf kan niet worden gepersonaliseerd. Personalisatie is altijd bij de prijs inbegrepen.

Heeft u vragen over de personalisatie van de urn? Stuur ons een bericht, wij helpen u graag.

Het zou ons een eer zijn om u te helpen op waardige wijze afscheid te nemen van uw hond.

INTERNATIONALE BESTELLINGEN
Onze producten worden vanuit Polen verzonden, daarom kunnen in sommige landen invoerkosten worden berekend. Deze kosten gelden niet voor EU-landen, het Verenigd Koninkrijk en de VS. Heeft u twijfels, neem dan contact met ons op voor details.
tlumaczenia.fr:
Quand arrive le jour le plus triste, cette urne faite main (race : Berger allemand) sera un lieu beau et digne pour les cendres de votre chien. Un lieu digne pour les cendres de votre chien, conçu pour rester près de vous, à la maison. Rendez-la vraiment unique : le nom, les dates et la citation de la plaquette gravée sont personnalisés pour votre chien.

CE QU'IL FAUT SAVOIR SUR L'URNE
- Urne en bois faite main pour les cendres d'animaux, en bois massif et contreplaqué, peinte en marron
- Portrait de la race (Berger allemand) en bas-relief de bronze coulé à froid (mélange de résine et de poudre de bronze) ; le bas-relief ne peut pas être personnalisé
- Plaquette gravée avec le nom, les dates et la citation, et un dessin délicat d'une patte de chien tenue dans une main humaine
- Dimensions extérieures : 21 x 29 x 22 cm (8,3 x 11,4 x 8,7 po)
- Dimensions intérieures : 14 x 21 x 15,5 cm (5,5 x 8,3 x 6,1 po), capacité env. 4,5 litres (275 pouces cubes)
- Poignées en laiton et décorations en bois sculpté
- Couvercle amovible, non étanche : pour bien fermer l'urne, collez-le avec une colle universelle

UN LIEU DE SOUVENIR
Dire adieu à un chien qui faisait partie de la famille n'est jamais facile. Cette urne offre à votre compagnon une place digne dans votre maison, où les souvenirs des promenades, des jeux et des soirées tranquilles peuvent rester proches. Les poignées en laiton et les décorations sculptées lui donnent un caractère classique et intemporel, et le bas-relief de la race est réalisé avec un grand soin pour les détails caractéristiques de la race.

PERSONNALISATION
Chaque urne est fabriquée sur commande. Indiquez-nous :
- Nom : le nom de votre chien, tel qu'il doit apparaître sur la plaquette.
- Dates : dates de naissance et de décès, dans le format de votre choix.
- Citation : la plaquette porte l'inscription "When I needed a hand, you gave me your paw" (en anglais uniquement), sauf si vous nous donnez votre propre texte exact.
Le bas-relief ne peut pas être personnalisé. La personnalisation est toujours incluse dans le prix.

Une question sur la personnalisation de l'urne ? Écrivez-nous, nous serons heureux de vous aider.

Ce sera un honneur pour nous de vous aider à dire adieu avec dignité à votre chien bien-aimé.

COMMANDES INTERNATIONALES
Nos produits sont expédiés depuis la Pologne ; des frais d'importation peuvent donc s'appliquer dans certains pays. Ils ne concernent pas les pays de l'UE, le Royaume-Uni ni les États-Unis. En cas de doute, contactez-nous pour obtenir des précisions.
tlumaczenia.it:
Quando arriva il giorno più triste, questa urna fatta a mano (razza: Pastore tedesco) sarà un luogo bello e dignitoso per le ceneri del suo cane. Un luogo degno per le ceneri del suo cane, pensato per essere tenuto vicino, a casa. La renda davvero unica: nome, date e citazione sulla targhetta incisa sono personalizzati per il suo cane.

DA SAPERE SULL'URNA
- Urna in legno fatta a mano per le ceneri di animali, in legno massello e compensato, dipinta di marrone
- Ritratto della razza (Pastore tedesco) in bassorilievo di bronzo fuso a freddo (miscela di resina e polvere di bronzo); il bassorilievo non può essere personalizzato
- Targhetta incisa con nome, date e citazione e una delicata grafica di una zampa di cane tenuta in una mano umana
- Dimensioni esterne: 21 x 29 x 22 cm (8,3 x 11,4 x 8,7 pollici)
- Dimensioni interne: 14 x 21 x 15,5 cm (5,5 x 8,3 x 6,1 pollici), capacità circa 4,5 litri (275 pollici cubi)
- Maniglie in ottone e decorazioni in legno intagliato
- Coperchio rimovibile, non a tenuta: per chiudere bene l'urna lo incolli con una colla universale

LUOGO DEL RICORDO
Dire addio a un cane che faceva parte della famiglia non è mai facile. Quest'urna offre al suo compagno un posto dignitoso nella sua casa, dove i ricordi di passeggiate, giochi e serate tranquille possono restare vicini. Le maniglie in ottone e le decorazioni intagliate le conferiscono un carattere classico e senza tempo, e il bassorilievo della razza è realizzato con grande cura per i dettagli caratteristici della razza.

PERSONALIZZAZIONE
Ogni urna viene realizzata su ordinazione. Ci indichi:
- Nome: il nome del suo cane, come deve comparire sulla targhetta.
- Date: date di nascita e di morte, nel formato che preferisce.
- Citazione: la targhetta riporta la scritta "When I needed a hand, you gave me your paw" (solo in inglese), a meno che non ci fornisca il suo testo esatto.
Il bassorilievo non può essere personalizzato. La personalizzazione è sempre inclusa nel prezzo.

Ha domande sulla personalizzazione dell'urna? Ci scriva, saremo lieti di aiutarla.

Sarà un onore per noi aiutarla a dire addio con dignità al suo cane.

ORDINI INTERNAZIONALI
I nostri prodotti vengono spediti dalla Polonia, quindi in alcuni paesi possono essere applicati costi di importazione. Questi costi non riguardano i paesi UE, il Regno Unito e gli Stati Uniti. In caso di dubbi, ci contatti per i dettagli.

- Placa gravada com nome, datas e citação e um gráfico delicado de uma pata de cão segurada numa mão humana

Tem dúvidas sobre a personalização da urna? Escreva-nos, teremos todo o gosto em ajudar.

Os nossos produtos são enviados da Polónia, pelo que em alguns países podem ser aplicados custos de importação. Estes custos não se aplicam aos países da UE, ao Reino Unido nem aos Estados Unidos. Em caso de dúvida, contacte-nos para obter detalhes.

tlumaczenia.sv:
När den sorgligaste dagen kommer blir den här handgjorda urnan (ras: Schäfer) en vacker och värdig plats för askan efter din hund. En värdig plats för askan efter din hund, gjord för att stå nära dig hemma. Gör den helt din egen: namn, datum och citat på den graverade namnskylten anpassas för din hund.

GOTT ATT VETA OM URNAN
- Handgjord träurna för husdjursaska, av massivt trä och plywood, målad i brunt
- Rasporträtt (Schäfer) som relief i kallgjuten brons (en blandning av harts och bronspulver); reliefen kan inte anpassas
- Graverad namnskylt med namn, datum och citat samt en fin grafik av en hundtass i en mänsklig hand
- Yttermått: 21 x 29 x 22 cm (8,3 x 11,4 x 8,7 tum)
- Innermått: 14 x 21 x 15,5 cm (5,5 x 8,3 x 6,1 tum), volym ca 4,5 liter (275 kubiktum)
- Mässingshandtag och dekorationer av snidat trä
- Avtagbart lock, inte tätt: för att stänga urnan ordentligt, limma fast det med universallim

EN PLATS FÖR MINNET
Att ta farväl av en hund som var en del av familjen är aldrig lätt. Den här urnan ger din följeslagare en värdig plats i ditt hem, där minnena av promenader, lek och lugna kvällar kan finnas nära. Mässingshandtagen och de snidade dekorationerna ger den en klassisk och tidlös karaktär, och rasens relief är gjord med stor omsorg om rasens karakteristiska detaljer.

PERSONLIG ANPASSNING
Varje urna tillverkas på beställning. Berätta för oss:
- Namn: din hunds namn, så som det ska stå på namnskylten.
- Datum: födelse- och dödsdatum, i valfritt format.
- Citat: namnskylten har inskriptionen "When I needed a hand, you gave me your paw" (endast på engelska), om du inte ger oss din egen exakta text.
Reliefen kan inte anpassas. Anpassningen ingår alltid i priset.

Har du frågor om anpassningen av urnan? Skriv till oss, vi hjälper dig gärna.

Det vore en ära för oss att hjälpa dig att ta ett värdigt farväl av din hund.

INTERNATIONELLA BESTÄLLNINGAR
Våra produkter skickas från Polen, så i vissa länder kan importavgifter tillkomma. Avgifterna gäller inte EU-länder, Storbritannien eller USA. Om du är osäker, kontakta oss så ger vi dig detaljerna.

The brass handles and carved decorations give it a classic, timeless look, and the relief portrait of the breed is made with great care for the details that are characteristic of the breed.

- Dates: dates of birth and death, in any format you like.

en_description:
A personalised wooden urn for your Rottweiler, with a cold cast bronze relief, made as a lasting place for your faithful Rottie. Keep it close as a lasting tribute to your faithful Rottie. A small engraved nameplate with your dog's name and dates can be added on request, and it is always included in the price.

THE URN AT A GLANCE
- Handmade wooden urn for pet ashes, made of solid wood and plywood, painted brown
- Relief portrait of a Rottweiler, cast in cold cast bronze (a mix of resin and bronze powder); the relief cannot be personalised
- As shown, the urn has no engraving; a small engraved nameplate with the name and dates can be added on request and is included in the price
- External size: 21 x 29 x 22 cm (8.3 x 11.4 x 8.7 in)
- Internal size: 14 x 21 x 15.5 cm (5.5 x 8.3 x 6.1 in), capacity approx. 4.5 litres (275 cubic inches)
- Brass handles and carved wooden decorations
- Removable lid, not sealed: glue it with any all-purpose glue to close it tightly

A PLACE OF REMEMBRANCE
Saying goodbye to a dog who was part of the family is never easy. This urn gives your companion a dignified place at home, where the memories of walks, play and quiet evenings can stay close. The brass handles and carved decorations give it a classic, timeless look, and the relief portrait of the breed is made with great care for the details that are characteristic of the breed.

PERSONALISATION
The urn is made to order. If you would like a small engraved nameplate, please tell us:
- Name: the name of your dog, as it should appear on the nameplate.
- Dates: dates of birth and death, in any format you like.
The nameplate always fits and is included in the price. The relief cannot be personalised.

Questions about personalising your urn? Send us a message, we will gladly help.

We would be honoured to help you say goodbye to your beloved dog with dignity.

INTERNATIONAL ORDERS
Our products are shipped from Poland, so import charges may apply in some countries. These charges do not apply to EU countries, the United Kingdom and the USA. If you have any doubts, please contact us for details.

tlumaczenia.de:

Unsere Produkte werden aus Polen versendet, daher können in einigen Ländern Einfuhrabgaben anfallen. Diese Abgaben gelten nicht für EU-Länder, das Vereinigte Königreich und die USA. Bei Fragen kontaktieren Sie uns gerne, wir nennen Ihnen die Details.
tlumaczenia.nl:

- Handgemaakte houten urn voor de as van huisdieren, van massief hout en multiplex, bruin geschilderd
- Reliëfportret van een Rottweiler, gegoten in koud gegoten brons (een mengsel van hars en bronspoeder); het reliëf kan niet worden gepersonaliseerd

Onze producten worden vanuit Polen verzonden, daarom kunnen in sommige landen invoerkosten worden berekend. Deze kosten gelden niet voor EU-landen, het Verenigd Koninkrijk en de VS. Heeft u twijfels, neem dan contact met ons op voor details.
tlumaczenia.fr:
Urne personnalisée avec un bas-relief en bronze coulé à froid, race : Rottweiler. Créée pour rendre hommage à un compagnon bien-aimé. Placez-la chez vous à l'endroit de votre choix, comme un hommage à votre chien, qui a fait partie de votre vie. Une petite plaquette gravée avec le nom et les dates de votre chien peut être ajoutée sur demande, toujours incluse dans le prix.

CE QU'IL FAUT SAVOIR SUR L'URNE
- Urne en bois faite main pour les cendres d'animaux, en bois massif et contreplaqué, peinte en marron
- Portrait de la race (Rottweiler) en bas-relief de bronze coulé à froid (mélange de résine et de poudre de bronze) ; le bas-relief ne peut pas être personnalisé
- Comme sur la photo, l'urne n'a pas de gravure ; sur demande, nous ajoutons une petite plaquette gravée avec le nom et les dates, incluse dans le prix
- Dimensions extérieures : 21 x 29 x 22 cm (8,3 x 11,4 x 8,7 po)
- Dimensions intérieures : 14 x 21 x 15,5 cm (5,5 x 8,3 x 6,1 po), capacité env. 4,5 litres (275 pouces cubes)
- Poignées en laiton et décorations en bois sculpté
- Couvercle amovible, non étanche : pour bien fermer l'urne, collez-le avec une colle universelle

UN LIEU DE SOUVENIR
Dire adieu à un chien qui faisait partie de la famille n'est jamais facile. Cette urne offre à votre compagnon une place digne dans votre maison, où les souvenirs des promenades, des jeux et des soirées tranquilles peuvent rester proches. Les poignées en laiton et les décorations sculptées lui donnent un caractère classique et intemporel, et le bas-relief de la race est réalisé avec un grand soin pour les détails caractéristiques de la race.

PERSONNALISATION
L'urne est fabriquée sur commande. Si vous souhaitez une petite plaquette gravée, indiquez-nous :
- Nom : le nom de votre chien, tel qu'il doit apparaître sur la plaquette.
- Dates : dates de naissance et de décès, dans le format de votre choix.
La plaquette trouve toujours sa place et est incluse dans le prix. Le bas-relief ne peut pas être personnalisé.

Une question sur la personnalisation de l'urne ? Écrivez-nous, nous serons heureux de vous aider.

Ce sera un honneur pour nous de vous aider à dire adieu avec dignité à votre chien bien-aimé.

COMMANDES INTERNATIONALES
Nos produits sont expédiés depuis la Pologne ; des frais d'importation peuvent donc s'appliquer dans certains pays. Ils ne concernent pas les pays de l'UE, le Royaume-Uni ni les États-Unis. En cas de doute, contactez-nous pour obtenir des précisions.

DA SAPERE SULL'URNA
- Urna in legno fatta a mano per le ceneri di animali, in legno massello e compensato, dipinta di marrone

Sarà un onore per noi aiutarla a dire addio con dignità al suo cane.

en_description:
A personalised wooden urn for your American Staffordshire Terrier, with a cold cast bronze relief, made as a lasting place for your faithful Amstaff. It can stand wherever you remember your dog, a gentle reminder of the companion you loved. You can personalise the name, dates and quote engraved on the nameplate.

THE URN AT A GLANCE
- Handmade wooden urn for pet ashes, made of solid wood and plywood, painted brown
- Relief portrait of an American Staffordshire Terrier, cast in cold cast bronze (a mix of resin and bronze powder); the relief cannot be personalised
- Engraved nameplate with the name, dates and quote, and a delicate graphic of a paw held in a human hand
- External size: 21 x 29 x 22 cm (8.3 x 11.4 x 8.7 in)
- Internal size: 14 x 21 x 15.5 cm (5.5 x 8.3 x 6.1 in), capacity approx. 4.5 litres (275 cubic inches)
- Brass handles and carved wooden decorations
- Removable lid, not sealed: glue it with any all-purpose glue to close it tightly

A PLACE OF REMEMBRANCE
Saying goodbye to a dog who was part of the family is never easy. This urn gives your companion a dignified place at home, where the memories of walks, play and quiet evenings can stay close. The brass handles and carved decorations give it a classic, timeless look, and the relief portrait of the breed is made with great care for the details that are characteristic of the breed.

PERSONALISATION
Every urn is made to order. Please tell us:
- Name: the name of your dog, as it should appear on the nameplate.
- Dates: dates of birth and death, in any format you like.
- Quote: the nameplate carries "When I needed a hand, you gave me your paw" unless you give us your own exact wording.
The relief cannot be personalised. Personalisation is always included in the price.

Questions about personalising your urn? Send us a message, we will gladly help.

We would be honoured to help you say goodbye to your beloved dog with dignity.

INTERNATIONAL ORDERS
Our products are shipped from Poland, so import charges may apply in some countries. These charges do not apply to EU countries, the United Kingdom and the USA. If you have any doubts, please contact us for details.

Every urn is made to order: add your dog's name and dates, keep the quote or choose your own, and we will engrave them on the nameplate.

- Handmade wooden urn for pet ashes, made of solid wood and plywood, painted brown

- Engraved nameplate with the name, dates and quote, and a delicate graphic of a paw held in a human hand
- External size: 21 x 29 x 22 cm (8.3 x 11.4 x 8.7 in)
- Internal size: 14 x 21 x 15.5 cm (5.5 x 8.3 x 6.1 in), capacity approx. 4.5 litres (275 cubic inches)

A PLACE OF REMEMBRANCE
Saying goodbye to a dog who was part of the family is never easy. This urn gives your companion a dignified place at home, where the memories of walks, play and quiet evenings can stay close. The brass handles and carved decorations give it a classic, timeless look, and the relief portrait of the breed is made with great care for the details that are characteristic of the breed.

PERSONALISATION
Every urn is made to order. Please tell us:
- Name: the name of your dog, as it should appear on the nameplate.
- Dates: dates of birth and death, in any format you like.
- Quote: the nameplate carries "When I needed a hand, you gave me your paw" unless you give us your own exact wording.
The relief cannot be personalised. Personalisation is always included in the price.

Questions about personalising your urn? Send us a message, we will gladly help.

We would be honoured to help you say goodbye to your beloved dog with dignity.

en_description:
A personalised wooden urn for your Newfoundland, with a cold cast bronze relief, made as a lasting place for your faithful Newfie. A fitting place for your dog's ashes, made to be kept close at home. The urn can also carry a nameplate with your dog's name and dates: just tell us when ordering, it is included in the price.

THE URN AT A GLANCE
- Handmade wooden urn for pet ashes, made of solid wood and plywood, painted brown
- Relief portrait of a Newfoundland, cast in cold cast bronze (a mix of resin and bronze powder); the relief cannot be personalised
- As shown, the urn has no engraving; a small engraved nameplate with the name and dates can be added on request and is included in the price
- External size: 21 x 29 x 22 cm (8.3 x 11.4 x 8.7 in)
- Internal size: 14 x 21 x 15.5 cm (5.5 x 8.3 x 6.1 in), capacity approx. 4.5 litres (275 cubic inches)
- Brass handles and carved wooden decorations
- Removable lid, not sealed: glue it with any all-purpose glue to close it tightly

A PLACE OF REMEMBRANCE
Saying goodbye to a dog who was part of the family is never easy. This urn gives your companion a dignified place at home, where the memories of walks, play and quiet evenings can stay close. The brass handles and carved decorations give it a classic, timeless look, and the relief portrait of the breed is made with great care for the details that are characteristic of the breed.

PERSONALISATION
The urn is made to order. If you would like a small engraved nameplate, please tell us:
- Name: the name of your dog, as it should appear on the nameplate.
- Dates: dates of birth and death, in any format you like.
The nameplate always fits and is included in the price. The relief cannot be personalised.

Questions about personalising your urn? Send us a message, we will gladly help.

We would be honoured to help you say goodbye to your beloved dog with dignity.

INTERNATIONAL ORDERS
Our products are shipped from Poland, so import charges may apply in some countries. These charges do not apply to EU countries, the United Kingdom and the USA. If you have any doubts, please contact us for details.

en_description:
This personalised pet urn features a cold cast bronze relief of a Boxer, created to honour a much-loved companion. It can stand wherever you remember your dog, a gentle reminder of the companion you loved. Tell us the name, dates and quote you would like, and we will engrave them on the nameplate.

THE URN AT A GLANCE
- Handmade wooden urn for pet ashes, made of solid wood and plywood, painted brown
- Relief portrait of a Boxer, cast in cold cast bronze (a mix of resin and bronze powder); the relief cannot be personalised
- Engraved nameplate with the name, dates and quote, and a delicate graphic of a paw held in a human hand
- External size: 21 x 29 x 22 cm (8.3 x 11.4 x 8.7 in)
- Internal size: 14 x 21 x 15.5 cm (5.5 x 8.3 x 6.1 in), capacity approx. 4.5 litres (275 cubic inches)
- Brass handles and carved wooden decorations
- Removable lid, not sealed: glue it with any all-purpose glue to close it tightly

A PLACE OF REMEMBRANCE
Saying goodbye to a dog who was part of the family is never easy. This urn gives your companion a dignified place at home, where the memories of walks, play and quiet evenings can stay close. The brass handles and carved decorations give it a classic, timeless look, and the relief portrait of the breed is made with great care for the details that are characteristic of the breed.

PERSONALISATION
Every urn is made to order. Please tell us:
- Name: the name of your dog, as it should appear on the nameplate.
- Dates: dates of birth and death, in any format you like.
- Quote: the nameplate carries "When I needed a hand, you gave me your paw" unless you give us your own exact wording.
The relief cannot be personalised. Personalisation is always included in the price.

Questions about personalising your urn? Send us a message, we will gladly help.

We would be honoured to help you say goodbye to your beloved dog with dignity.

INTERNATIONAL ORDERS
Our products are shipped from Poland, so import charges may apply in some countries. These charges do not apply to EU countries, the United Kingdom and the USA. If you have any doubts, please contact us for details.

en_description:
Remember your English Bulldog with this handmade wooden urn for dog ashes, with a cold cast bronze relief portrait. Keep it at home in a quiet place, a lasting tribute to the dog who shared your life. You can personalise the name, dates and quote engraved on the nameplate.

THE URN AT A GLANCE
- Handmade wooden urn for pet ashes, made of solid wood and plywood, painted brown
- Relief portrait of a Bulldog, cast in cold cast bronze (a mix of resin and bronze powder); the relief cannot be personalised
- Engraved nameplate with the name, dates and quote, and a delicate graphic of a paw held in a human hand
- External size: 21 x 29 x 22 cm (8.3 x 11.4 x 8.7 in)
- Internal size: 14 x 21 x 15.5 cm (5.5 x 8.3 x 6.1 in), capacity approx. 4.5 litres (275 cubic inches)
- Brass handles and carved wooden decorations
- Removable lid, not sealed: glue it with any all-purpose glue to close it tightly

A PLACE OF REMEMBRANCE
Saying goodbye to a dog who was part of the family is never easy. This urn gives your companion a dignified place at home, where the memories of walks, play and quiet evenings can stay close. The brass handles and carved decorations give it a classic, timeless look, and the relief portrait of the breed is made with great care for the details that are characteristic of the breed.

PERSONALISATION
Every urn is made to order. Please tell us:
- Name: the name of your dog, as it should appear on the nameplate.
- Dates: dates of birth and death, in any format you like.
- Quote: the nameplate carries "When I needed a hand, you gave me your paw" unless you give us your own exact wording.
The relief cannot be personalised. Personalisation is always included in the price.

Questions about personalising your urn? Send us a message, we will gladly help.

We would be honoured to help you say goodbye to your beloved dog with dignity.

INTERNATIONAL ORDERS
Our products are shipped from Poland, so import charges may apply in some countries. These charges do not apply to EU countries, the United Kingdom and the USA. If you have any doubts, please contact us for details.

- Engraved nameplate with the name, dates and quote, and a delicate graphic of a paw held in a human hand
- External size: 21 x 29 x 22 cm (8.3 x 11.4 x 8.7 in)
- Internal size: 14 x 21 x 15.5 cm (5.5 x 8.3 x 6.1 in), capacity approx. 4.5 litres (275 cubic inches)

A PLACE OF REMEMBRANCE
Saying goodbye to a dog who was part of the family is never easy. This urn gives your companion a dignified place at home, where the memories of walks, play and quiet evenings can stay close. The brass handles and carved decorations give it a classic, timeless look, and the relief portrait of the breed is made with great care for the details that are characteristic of the breed.

PERSONALISATION
Every urn is made to order. Please tell us:
- Name: the name of your dog, as it should appear on the nameplate.
- Dates: dates of birth and death, in any format you like.
- Quote: the nameplate carries "When I needed a hand, you gave me your paw" unless you give us your own exact wording.

Questions about personalising your urn? Send us a message, we will gladly help.

We would be honoured to help you say goodbye to your beloved dog with dignity.

INTERNATIONAL ORDERS
Our products are shipped from Poland, so import charges may apply in some countries. These charges do not apply to EU countries, the United Kingdom and the USA. If you have any doubts, please contact us for details.

THE URN AT A GLANCE

- Relief portrait of a Fila Brasileiro, cast in cold cast bronze (a mix of resin and bronze powder); the relief cannot be personalised
- Engraved nameplate with the name, dates and quote, and a delicate graphic of a paw held in a human hand
- External size: 21 x 29 x 22 cm (8.3 x 11.4 x 8.7 in)
- Internal size: 14 x 21 x 15.5 cm (5.5 x 8.3 x 6.1 in), capacity approx. 4.5 litres (275 cubic inches)

A PLACE OF REMEMBRANCE

PERSONALISATION

- Name: the name of your dog, as it should appear on the nameplate.
- Dates: dates of birth and death, in any format you like.
- Quote: the nameplate carries "When I needed a hand, you gave me your paw" unless you give us your own exact wording.
The relief cannot be personalised. Personalisation is always included in the price.

Questions about personalising your urn? Send us a message, we will gladly help.

We would be honoured to help you say goodbye to your beloved dog with dignity.

INTERNATIONAL ORDERS
Our products are shipped from Poland, so import charges may apply in some countries. These charges do not apply to EU countries, the United Kingdom and the USA. If you have any doubts, please contact us for details.

en_description:
A personalised wooden urn for your French Bulldog, with a cold cast bronze relief, made as a lasting place for your faithful Frenchie. It can stand wherever you remember your dog, a gentle reminder of the companion you loved. Tell us the name and dates of your Frenchie and choose the quote, and we will engrave them on the nameplate.

THE URN AT A GLANCE
- Handmade wooden urn for pet ashes, made of solid wood and plywood, painted brown
- Relief portrait of a French Bulldog, cast in cold cast bronze (a mix of resin and bronze powder); the relief cannot be personalised
- Engraved nameplate with the name, dates and quote, and a delicate graphic of a paw held in a human hand
- External size: 21 x 29 x 22 cm (8.3 x 11.4 x 8.7 in)
- Internal size: 14 x 21 x 15.5 cm (5.5 x 8.3 x 6.1 in), capacity approx. 4.5 litres (275 cubic inches)

A PLACE OF REMEMBRANCE
Saying goodbye to a dog who was part of the family is never easy. This urn gives your companion a dignified place at home, where the memories of walks, play and quiet evenings can stay close. The brass handles and carved decorations give it a classic, timeless look, and the relief portrait of the breed is made with great care for the details that are characteristic of the breed.

PERSONALISATION
Every urn is made to order. Please tell us:
- Name: the name of your dog, as it should appear on the nameplate.

- Quote: the nameplate carries "When I needed a hand, you gave me your paw" unless you give us your own exact wording.
The relief cannot be personalised. Personalisation is always included in the price.

Questions about personalising your urn? Send us a message, we will gladly help.

We would be honoured to help you say goodbye to your beloved dog with dignity.

INTERNATIONAL ORDERS
Our products are shipped from Poland, so import charges may apply in some countries. These charges do not apply to EU countries, the United Kingdom and the USA. If you have any doubts, please contact us for details.
